title: vintageverb
description: `vintageverb` is a stereo reverb unit that processes a signal input and provides left and right outputs. It offers controls for dry/wet balance, tail length, room size, wobble, slight distortion, muddiness, and stereo width, with CV inputs for size, width, and dry/wet; eight slots can store and load parameter combinations, with trigger/gate inputs for sequential or random selection.
